Source: STDI-0002-1 v2021.1, Appendix P: GEOSDE RSM
Name: Map Source Description
Description: The map source data extension (SOURC) provides extensive information about the source graphics (one or more). Since these sources are maps or charts, a cartographic (MAP) coordinate system applies and must include ellipsoid, datum, and projection data. In addition, if elevation or depth information is present on the source map, then the vertical or sounding datum must be supplied.

IS_SCA.Name: Image Segment Reciprocal Scale
IS_SCA.Description: This field shall contain the reciprocal scale of the Image Segment (e.g., 50000 for 1:50000). This is usually the scale of the source material.

CPATCH.Name: Color Patch Identifier
CPATCH.Description: This field shall contain the identification of the Image Segment (IID1 field), which contains the color patch, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the current Image Segment is not associated with any color patch. The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20).

NUM_SOUR.Name: Number of Source Descriptions
NUM_SOUR.Description: The image contained in the current Image Segment may be derived from one or many original sources (i.e., paper maps). This field shall contain the number of source descriptions to follow; that is, the number of original sources used to produce the image.

NUM_BP<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Number of Bounding Polygons for the nth Source
NUM_BP<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the number of bounding polygons defining the part of the image concerned with the nth source description. If the source description applies to the entire Image Segment (necessary when the GEOPS extension is not present), then this field contains 00.

NUM_PTS<NUM_BP<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Number of Points in the pth Bounding Polygon of the nth Source
NUM_PTS<NUM_BP<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the value of NUM_BPn is greater than 00 and shall be omitted otherwise. When present, this field shall contain the number of points (coordinate pairs) that are used to define the pth bounding polygon of the nth source description. Whenever possible, the first and last points should be the same in order to close the polygon (e.g., a rectangular region would report five points), though this is not a requirement. Coordinate values shall refer to the coordinate system and units defined in GEOPS (and possibly in PRJPS).

LON<NUM_PTS<NUM_BP<NUM_SOUR>>>.Name: Longitude or Easting
LON<NUM_PTS<NUM_BP<NUM_SOUR>>>.Description: This field is required when the value of NUM_BPn is greater than 00 and shall be omitted otherwise. When present, this field shall contain the Easting (when the value of GEOPS UNI is M) or Longitude (otherwise of the mth point of the pth bounding polygon of the nth source.

LAT<NUM_PTS<NUM_BP<NUM_SOUR>>>.Name: Latitude or Northing
LAT<NUM_PTS<NUM_BP<NUM_SOUR>>>.Description: This field is required when the value of NUM_BPn is greater than 00 and shall be omitted otherwise. When present, this field shall contain the Northing (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or Latitude (otherwise) of the mth point of the pth bounding polygon of the nth source.

PRT<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Series Designator
PRT<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the series designator (e.g., 1501G) of the nth original source. The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20) but, a significant value is highly recommended.

URF<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Source Identification
URF<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain a source identification that is a number or name which, when used with series and edition, will uniquely identify the nth original source.

EDN<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Edition Number
EDN<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the edition number of the nth original source.

NAM<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Source Name
NAM<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the full name of the nth original source document. The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20), but a significant value is highly recommended.

CDP<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Type of Significant Date
CDP<NUM_SOUR>.Description: A significant date is a designated date that most accurately describes basic date of the product for computation of the probable obsolescence date. It can be compilation date, revision date, or other depending on the product and circumstances. This field shall contain the type of the nth original source significant date. The default value is 029, which means significant date.

CDV<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Significant Date
CDV<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain a significant date of the nth original source. The type of the date is specified by the CDPn field.

CDV27<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Perishable Date
CDV27<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the perishable information date code of the nth original source. The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20) but, a significant value is highly recommended.

SRN<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Source Reference Number
SRN<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field can contain a reference number of the nth original source. The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20).

SCA<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Reciprocal Scale
SCA<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the reciprocal of cartographic scale (e.g., 50000 for 1/50000 scale). The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20) but, a significant value is expected when defined on the source material.

UNISQU<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Unit of Measure for Coverage
UNISQU<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the unit of measure of the nth original source coverage, or all BCS spaces (0x20) when this information is unknown or not applicable. The default units are square kilometers (KM2). The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20).

SQU<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Source Coverage
SQU<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field is omitted when UNISQUn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the coverage of the nth original source; that is, a number with units as specified above, specifying how many square units of area coverage (e.g., 43000 in the case of 43,000 km2).

UNIPCI<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Unit of Measure for Contour Interval
UNIPCI<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the unit of measure of the nth original source contour interval, or all BCS spaces (0x20) when this information is unknown or not applicable. The default units are meters (M). Default value is all BCS spaces (0x20).

PCI<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Contour Interval
PCI<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIPCIn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the predominant contour interval of the nth original source.

WPC<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Water Coverage
WPC<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the percentage of the nth original source covered by water, or 999 if this information is unknown. The default value is 999.

NST<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Navigation System Type
NST<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the navigation system type (e.g., the value 007 corresponds to LORAN, that is, the Long Range Air Navigation System) concerning the nth original source, or 000 if this information is unknown. The default value is 000.

UNIHKE<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Units of HKE
UNIHKE<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the unit of measure of the highest known elevation on the nth original source, or all BCS spaces (0x20) when this information is unknown or not applicable. The default units are meters (M). The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20).

HKE<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Highest Known Elevation
HKE<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIHKEn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the highest known elevation of the nth original source.

LONHKE<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Longitude/Easting of HKE
LONHKE<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIHKEn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the Easting (when the value of GEPOS.UNI is M) or the longtitude of teh highest known elevation on the Nth original source. This value shall refer to the coordinate system and units defined in GEOPS (and possibly PRJPS).

LATHKE<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Latitude/Northing of HKE
LATHKE<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field is omitted when UNIHKEn contains all BCS spaces (0x20). Otherwise, this field shall contain the Northing (when the value of GEOPS UNI is M) or the latitude (otherwise) of the highest know elevation on the nth original source. This value shall refer to the coordinate system and units defined in GEOPS (and possibly PRJPS).

QSS<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Security Classification of Source
QSS<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field contains the security classification of the nth original source. Valid values are T (TOP SECRET), S (SECRET), C (CONFIDENTIAL), R (RESTRICTED for NATO, or alternatively FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY for the U.S.), and U (UNCLASSIFIED). The default value is U.

CDV10<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Downgrading Date
CDV10<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field is omitted when the value of QSSn is U or when the value of QODn is Y. When present, this field shall contain the date of downgrading of the nth original source.

QLE<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Releasing Instrucitons
QLE<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the releasing instructions/restrictions for the nth original source. The default value is UNRESTRICTED and indicates that no release restriction exists.

CPY<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Releasing Instrucitons
CPY<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the releasing instructions/restrictions for the nth original source. The default value is UNRESTRICTED and indicates that no release restriction exists.

NMI<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Number of magnetic Information
NMI<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the number of sets of magnetic infromation derived from the nth original source.

CDV30<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Date of Magnetic Information
CDV30<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the vlue of NMIn is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the date of the pth set of agnetic information derived from the nth original source.

UNIRAT<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Units for Annual Rate of Change
UNIRAT<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the vlue of NMIn is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the unit of measure of the annual angular magnetic reate of change related to the pth set of magnetic information. The default value is DEG (decimal degrees).

RAT<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Annual Rate of Change
RAT<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the vlue of NMIn is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the annual angular magnetic rate of change related to the pth set of magnetic information.

UNIGMA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Units of GMAnp
UNIGMA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the vlue of NMIn is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the unit of measure of the GMAnp fied for the pth set of magnetic infromation. The default value is DEG (decimal degrees).

GMA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: G-M Angle
GMA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the vlue of NMIn is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the grid magnetic angle (GMA): grid North to magnetic North (clickwise regarded as positive) field for the pth set of magnetic information.

LONGMA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Longitude/Easting of GMAnp Reference Point
LONGMA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the vlue of NMIn is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the Easting (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or the longitude (otherwise) of the GMAnp reference point of the pth set of magnetic information, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the information is unknown This value shall refer to the coordinate system and units defined in GEOPS (and possibly PRJPS). The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20).

LATGMA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Latitude/Northing of GMAnp Reference Point
LATGMA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the vlue of NMIn is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the Northing (when the value of GEOPS.UNI is M) or the longitude (otherwise) of the GMAnp reference point of the pth set of magnetic information, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if the information is unknown This value shall refer to the coordinate system and units defined in GEOPS (and possibly PRJPS). The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20).

UNIGCA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Units of GCAnp
UNIGCA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the vlue of NMIn is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the unit of measure of the grid convergence angle (GCA) field for the pth set of magnetic information, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if this information is unknown. The default unit of measure is DEG (decimal degrees). The default value is all BCS spaces (0x20).

GCA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Grid Convergence Angle
GCA<NMI<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is omitted when the value of NMIn is 00 or when the value of UNIGCAnp is all BCS spaces (0x20). When present, this field shall contain the grid convergence angle related to the pth set of magnetic information.

NLI<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Number of Legend Images
NLI<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain teh number of legend images derived from the nth original source.

BAD<NLI<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Legend Image ID
BAD<NLI<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the value of the NLIn field is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the identification of the Image Segment (IID1 field), which contains the pth legend image associated with the nth original source.

DAG<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the name of the geodetic datum to which the nth original source refers. The default value is World Geodetic System 1984.

DCD<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the code of the geodetic datum to which the nth original source refers. The default value is WGE.

ELC<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Ellipsoid Code
ELC<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the code of the ellipsoid to which the nth original source refers. The default value is WE.

DVR<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Vertical Datum Reference
DVR<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the name of the vertical datum reference to which the nth original source refers, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if no elevation appears in the nth original source. The default name is Geodetic.

Values: Name of a Gravity-Related Surface (e.g., Mean Sea Level Singapore or EGM96 Model Geoid

VDCDVR<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Code (Category) of Vertical Reference
VDCDVR<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the code (or category) of the vertical reference to which the nth original source refers, or all BCS spaces (0x20 if no elevations appears in the nth original source. The default code is GEOD.

SDA<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Sounding Datum Name
SDA<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the name of the sounding datum to which the nth original source refers, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if no sounding appears in the nth original source. The default name is Mean Sea.

Values: Local Datum (arbitrary datum defined by local harbour authority)

VDCSDA<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Code for Sounding Datum
VDCSDA<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the code of the sounding datum to which the nth original source refers, or all BCS spaces (0x20) if no sounding appears in the nth original source. The default code is MSL.

PRN<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Projection Name
PRN<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the name of the projection to which the nth orignal source refers. The default value is Transvers Mercator.

Values: Hotine Oblique Mercator based on 2 Points

PCO<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Projection Code
PCO<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the code of the projection to which the nth orignal source refers. The default code is TC.

NUM_PRJ<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Number of Projection Parameters
NUM_PRJ<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the number of projection parameters. The PRJnp field should repeat as necessary depending on the projection code (see Table p-20; originally from Part 3-6 of DIGEST Ed. 2.1). If the number of projection parameters provided in the TRE is lower than specified in Table P-20 (originally from Part 3-6 of DIGEST Ed. 2.1), then the missing parameter values shall be assigned a value of 0.

PRJ<NUM_PRJ<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Projection Parameter
PRJ<NUM_PRJ<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field provides an appropriate parameter to accurately describe the projection. See Table P-20 (originally from Part 3-6 of DIGEST Ed. 2.1) to know the kind of parameters needed for each valid projection code.

XOR<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Projection False X (Easting) Origin
XOR<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the projection false X (Easting) origin. The default value is 000000000000000, which implies that there is no projection false X origin.

YOR<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Projection False Y (Northing) Origin
YOR<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the projection false Y (Northing) origin. The default value is 000000000000000, which implies that there is no projection false Y origin.

GRD<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Grid Code
GRD<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the identification code of the grid system to which the th original source refers, or all BCS spaces (0x20). The default is all BCS spaces (0x20).

GRN<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Grid Description
GRN<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field contains a text description of the grid system to which the nth original source refers.

ZNA<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Grid Zone Number
ZNA<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the zone number when the GRDn field contains a significant grid code and the corresponding grid system comrises more than one zone. Default is 0000 otherwise.

NIN<NUM_SOUR>.Name: Number of Insets
NIN<NUM_SOUR>.Description: This field shall contain the number of insets derived from teh nth original source.

INT<NIN<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Inset Identification
INT<NIN<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the value of NINn is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the identification of the Image Segment (IID1 field), which contains the pth inset associated with the nth original source.

INS_SCA<NIN<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Reciprocal Scale of Inset
INS_SCA<NIN<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the value of NINn is greater than 00. When present, this field shall contain the reciprocal scale (e.g. 50000 for 1:50000) of the pth inset associated with the nth original source.

NTL<NIN<NUM_SOUR>>.Name: Absolute Longitude/Easting of Lower Left Corner
NTL<NIN<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the value of NINn is greater than 00. The Longitude/Easting shall refer to the coordinate system and units defined in GEOPS (and possibly PRJPS).

NRR<NIN<NUM_SOUR>>.Description: This field is required when the value of NINn is greater than 00.
